## Labcoat Leni 12.1

Muris et al. (2008): *Space invaders*

Does negative feedback training make children interpret situations more negatively?

- `training`: positive vs. negative feedback in 30 scenarios
- `int_bias`: high = interprets situations negatively
- Adjusting for `age`, `gender` and `scared` (child anxiety)
